notes: The eight issues of February to July 2026, which a previous run's batching by archive page skipped: the pass that read "page 1" took only the August and September 2026 issues, and the two that followed batched pages 2 and 3. Six are monthly Neighborhood News issues, two are one-page notices with no historical content. The February and May issues are the densest researched articles in the whole archive - a block history of 2655 (1200 Clayton and its successors) and a two-part construction history of 104-106-108 Ord Street.

coverage.remaining: Nothing on the newsletter's first archive page. The twenty issues of November 2023 to December 2024 are in issues-2023-11-to-2024-12.
coverage.note: Sixty-one numbered-address mentions across the six substantive issues. The February issue's photograph captions account for eight of them - the 1972 assessor-style shots of 1222 and 1230 Clayton that name a street number and the cars parked outside it, and nothing about the building. The March issue's Castro Theatre history is the one stretch of this batch a reader could already find by searching.

Nothing was built again on 123 and 127 Corbett Avenue until 1937.
